subject: Re: Saturday appointment
text:
Hi Mara,

Thanks for checking in about Saturday. I can still meet at the cafe near the park at ten, unless something changes on your end. I tried to update the calendar invite, but my laptop keeps freezing whenever I open the event details. I don't think it will take long, though, because a quick restart usually fixes it. If it happens again, I'll just use my phone and message you once I arrive. Also, if you're running early, feel free to grab a window seat; I always get distracted by the street musicians outside. Bring the notes from the garden cleanup, if you still have them. I'd rather not forget who was supposed to drop off the extra mulch and who owed a favor for fixing the hose connector. If the calendar app stays stuck, I'll send a fresh invitation by this evening so we both have a clear reminder. Either way, I'll text you when I'm five minutes out so you won't need to watch the door.

See you then,
Jonas
